metadata.description: High-fidelity audit checklist for trust boundary edge security properties

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX: Ensure all user-submitted transactions undergo comprehensive validation before acceptance
detection_procedure: 1. Navigate to the JSON-RPC handler for eth_sendRawTransaction in internal/ethapi/api.go
2. Trace the call path from SendRawTransaction to the transaction pool validation logic
3. Verify that core/txpool/validation.go ValidateTransaction is called before any acceptance
4. Confirm signature verification occurs via crypto.Ecrecover before pool insertion
5. Check nonce validation against the current state in core/state_transition.go
6. Verify balance check: account.Balance >= tx.GasPrice * tx.GasLimit + tx.Value
7. Confirm gas limit bounds checking (intrinsic gas calculation in core/state_transition.go)
8. Verify EIP-specific validation (EIP-1559 fee caps, EIP-2930 access lists, EIP-4844 blob txs)
9. Ensure malformed RLP-encoded transactions are rejected without state modification
10. Test: submit malformed transaction data and verify clean rejection with appropriate error

executable_checks.assertion: Validation function is called on all entry paths

executable_checks.command: trace call graph from ethapi.SendRawTransaction to txpool.Add

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 to hold true in the code. This is the PRIMARY attack surface - UNTRUSTED -> TRUSTED boundary.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX correctly enforces comprehensive transaction validation to protect the boundary
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX implementation in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go validateTx()
2. Verify all validation checks are present:
a. Transaction size limit check (maxTxSize)
b. Negative value check (tx.Value() >= 0)
c. Gas limit vs block gas limit check
d. Signature verification and sender recovery
e. Nonce validation (current nonce <= tx.nonce <= current + maxQueuedPerAccount)
f. Balance sufficiency check
g. Intrinsic gas calculation
3. Verify rejection paths lead to STATE-TX-REJECTED without side effects
4. Check for EIP-4844 blob transaction specific validation if applicable
5. Verify no partial validation states that could allow pool insertion

executable_checks.assertion: Validation function exists and is comprehensive

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Node ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. This action node implements the validation gate that protects the EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX: Confirm no validation bypass paths exist in the codebase
detection_procedure: 1. Map all entry points that can add transactions to the pool:
a. eth_sendRawTransaction RPC
b. eth_sendTransaction RPC (for unlocked accounts)
c. P2P transaction propagation (IMPLICIT-P2P-TX-RECEIVE)
d. Any internal transaction injection points
2. For each entry point, trace to validateTx() call
3. Search for any AddLocal, AddRemote, or similar that bypasses validation
4. Check for debug/admin endpoints that might allow unvalidated insertion
5. Verify no race conditions between validation and insertion
6. Examine pool reset/reorg logic for validation invariant maintenance

executable_checks.assertion: All add functions validate or require pre-validated transactions
All pool.Add calls are through validated paths

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX. This check ensures the graph property 'no bypass path exists' holds in the actual implementation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for IMPLICIT-P2P-TX-RECEIVE: P2P received transactions undergo same validation as user-submitted
detection_procedure: 1. Locate P2P transaction handler in eth/handler.go and eth/protocols/eth/handlers.go
2. Trace HandleTransactions or similar P2P message handlers
3. Verify P2P transactions flow through identical validateTx() path
4. Check for any 'trusted peer' exemptions that reduce validation
5. Verify DoS protections are applied:
a. Rate limiting per peer
b. Maximum pending transactions per peer
c. Fee-based prioritization
6. Confirm malicious peer detection and disconnection logic
7. Verify no amplification attacks possible via P2P transaction relay

executable_checks.assertion: P2P handlers route through standard validation
Rate limiting is implemented for P2P transactions

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-TX-RECEIVE-001 → Edge IMPLICIT-P2P-TX-RECEIVE. This check verifies P2P transactions from SEMI_TRUSTED peers receive full validation. HIGH RISK BOUNDARY: Peers may forward invalid transactions intentionally.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE: Blocks from P2P peers undergo complete validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block import handler in eth/downloader/ and core/blockchain.go
2. Trace InsertChain and related block import functions
3. Verify complete validation pipeline:
a. Header validation (core/block_validator.go ValidateHeader)
b. Transaction root verification against header
c. Full transaction execution via state processor
d. State root comparison after execution
e. Receipts root verification
4. Confirm invalid blocks trigger peer penalization (eth/protocols/eth/peer.go)
5. Check for any fast-path imports that skip validation
6. Verify ancestor validation for chain reorganizations
7. Test: Craft block with invalid state root and verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE-001 → Edge IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE. CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Attack surface for consensus-breaking attacks. Invalid blocks must be rejected and peers penalized.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE: JWT authentication is mandatory before processing forkchoiceUpdated
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Engine API handler in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Find ForkchoiceUpdatedV1/V2/V3 implementations
3. Trace back to HTTP handler registration in node/rpcstack.go
4. Verify JWT middleware (node/jwt_handler.go) is applied to Engine API
5. Check JWT validation logic:
a. Signature verification using shared secret
b. Expiration check (iat claim within acceptable window)
c. Proper error response for invalid tokens
6. Verify no alternative paths to ForkchoiceUpdated bypass JWT
7. Check for timing side channels in JWT validation
8. Confirm JWT secret file permissions are checked at startup
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE-001 → Edge EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE. This check verifies HS256 JWT authentication protects this trusted -> trusted boundary over network socket.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT correctly enforces HS256 JWT validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT validation in node/jwt_handler.go
2. Verify HS256 algorithm enforcement (reject other algorithms)
3. Check signature verification against shared secret from jwt.hex file
4. Verify 'iat' (issued at) claim validation within ±60 second window
5. Check for algorithm confusion vulnerabilities (e.g., accepting 'none')
6. Verify constant-time comparison for signature verification
7. Check error handling does not leak timing information
8. Verify secret file is read at startup and properly protected
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE-001 → Node ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. Critical authentication control point. Implementation must reject expired tokens and validate signature correctly.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD: JWT authentication precedes all payload processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate NewPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4 in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify registration under authenticated Engine API namespace
3. Confirm no direct HTTP paths bypass JWT middleware
4. Trace request flow: HTTP → JWT validation → NewPayload handler
5. Verify error responses for unauthenticated requests
6. Check for any internal testing or debug modes that bypass auth
7. Verify authentication occurs before any payload parsing
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD-001 → Edge EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD. Although CL is trusted, payloads may originate from malicious validators. JWT protects the channel.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD: Full payload validation regardless of trusted source
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, trace NewPayload through validation chain
2. Verify structural validation occurs (ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE):
a. Block hash computation and comparison
b. Parent hash existence check
c. Timestamp ordering validation
d. Transaction root verification
3. Verify full block processing (ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK):
a. All transactions are executed
b. State root is computed and compared
4. Confirm trust in CL doesn't skip any validation step
5. Check for any 'optimistic' import paths that defer validation

executable_checks.assertion: Payload conversion and validation functions exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD-002 → Edge EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD. MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Trust in CL doesn't extend to payload content. Defense in depth requires full validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD: JWT authentication and valid PayloadID required
detection_procedure: 1. Locate GetPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4 in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify registration under authenticated Engine API namespace
3. Check PayloadID validation:
a. ID must correspond to active build from forkchoiceUpdated
b. ID must not be reusable after retrieval
c. ID must expire after timeout
4. Verify only authenticated CL can retrieve payloads
5. Check for payload ID enumeration vulnerabilities
6. Verify proper error responses for invalid/expired PayloadIDs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD-001 → Edge EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD. JWT authentication and valid PayloadID required. Only CL that initiated build can retrieve.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETRIEVED: Built payload is valid and correctly formed
detection_procedure: 1. Locate payload building in miner/payload_building.go or miner/worker.go
2. Verify payload construction uses only validated transactions
3. Check block hash is correctly computed before return
4. Verify blob sidecar KZG commitments (for Cancun+ payloads):
a. Blobs match commitments
b. Proofs are valid
5. Confirm payload attributes from forkchoiceUpdated are respected
6. Verify no race conditions during payload building that could corrupt data
7. Check payload timeout behavior returns latest valid payload

executable_checks.assertion: Blob handling is implemented for Cancun+

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETRIEVED-001 → Edge EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETRIEVED. EL -> CL response with built payload. Block hash integrity and blob KZG commitments must be verified.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-TX-INCLUDED: Only validated transactions from pending pool are selected for block inclusion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transaction selection in miner/worker.go commitTransactions()
2. Verify transactions are sourced only from STATE-TX-PENDING (validated pool)
3. Check no direct transaction injection paths bypass pool
4. Verify transaction re-validation during execution (defense in depth):
a. Nonce check against current state
b. Balance check for execution
5. Confirm pool eviction doesn't allow re-inclusion of rejected transactions
6. Check transaction ordering respects gas price priority

executable_checks.assertion: Transaction commit function sources from pool

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TX-INCLUDED-001 → Edge EDGE-TX-INCLUDED. Transactions from pool (originally untrusted source) to block builder. Pool invariant ensures pre-validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VALID-COMMIT: State commitment only after complete block validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate state commit in core/state/statedb.go Commit()
2. Trace call paths to Commit and verify they originate from valid block states
3. Verify state root comparison occurs BEFORE commit:
a. Computed state root must match header's state root
b. Mismatch must prevent commit
4. Check for atomic commit semantics (no partial state commits)
5. Verify rollback on validation failure (state is discarded)
6. Check database transaction isolation during commit
7. Verify commit is idempotent (same state produces same root)

executable_checks.assertion: State commit is called after validation
State root computation exists for comparison

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALID-COMMIT-001 → Edge EDGE-VALID-COMMIT. BOUNDARY: State commitment to persistent storage. Merkle Patricia Trie integrity. Atomic and verified.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VALID-COMMIT: Merkle Patricia Trie provides cryptographic integrity for committed state
detection_procedure: 1. Verify MPT implementation in trie/trie.go and trie/secure_trie.go
2. Check hash computation uses Keccak256 consistently
3. Verify node serialization is canonical (RLP encoding)
4. Check proof generation and verification in trie/proof.go
5. Verify batch writes are atomic at database level
6. Check for any state pruning that could affect integrity
7. Verify snapshot generation maintains consistency with MPT

executable_checks.assertion: RLP encoding is used for serialization

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-VALID-COMMIT-002 → Edge EDGE-VALID-COMMIT. Merkle Patricia Trie provides tamper-evident state commitment. Atomic commit ensures consistency.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BP-APPLY: EVM receives correct context and message data is properly isolated
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ApplyTransaction in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify message conversion from transaction preserves integrity
3. Check EVM context setup:
a. Block context (number, timestamp, coinbase, etc.)
b. Transaction context (gas price, origin, etc.)
4. Verify calldata (DATA-MESSAGE.Data) is passed without modification
5. Check EVM sandbox setup prevents context corruption
6. Verify gas limit from message is correctly applied
7. Check for any pre-execution hooks that could modify context
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-APPLY-001 → Edge EDGE-BP-APPLY. User data (calldata) flows into EVM. EVM sandbox must contain execution. Context must be correctly set.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ST-CREATE: EVM safely executes untrusted initcode without system compromise
detection_procedure: 1. Locate contract creation in core/vm/evm.go Create() and Create2()
2. Verify EIP-3860 initcode size limit enforcement:
a. Maximum initcode size: 49152 bytes (2 * MAX_CODE_SIZE)
b. Initcode gas cost charged correctly
3. Verify gas limits are correctly applied and consumed
4. Check call depth limit enforcement (1024)
5. Verify memory expansion costs prevent unbounded allocation
6. Check created contract code size limit (MAX_CODE_SIZE = 24576)
7. Verify initcode execution cannot modify state outside contract
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-ST-CREATE-001 → Edge EDGE-ST-CREATE. MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Initcode is untrusted user data. EVM sandbox is the security perimeter. Gas limits, call depth limits, EIP-3860 bound resources.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ST-CALL: EVM safely executes arbitrary bytecode with untrusted calldata
detection_procedure: 1. Locate contract call in core/vm/evm.go Call()
2. Verify gas metering for all opcodes in core/vm/jump_table.go
3. Check stack limit enforcement (1024 items)
4. Verify memory expansion cost calculation
5. Check state isolation:
a. Each call frame has isolated memory
b. Storage access is properly scoped
c. Return data is copied, not referenced
6. Verify reentrancy protection via gas limits
7. Check precompile call safety (core/vm/contracts.go)
8. Verify DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, STATICCALL proper isolation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-ST-CALL-001 → Edge EDGE-ST-CALL. MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Calldata from untrusted source into EVM. Gas metering, stack/memory limits, state isolation provide sandboxing.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-TRANSACTION validation completeness for signature, nonce, balance, gas, and format
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transaction types in core/types/transaction.go
2. Verify signature validation in core/types/transaction_signing.go:
a. R, S value range checks (0 < r < secp256k1 order)
b. V value validation for chain ID
c. Signature malleability prevention
3. Verify RLP decoding handles malformed input safely
4. Check all transaction type validations:
a. Legacy (Type 0)
b. EIP-2930 AccessList (Type 1)
c. EIP-1559 DynamicFee (Type 2)
d. EIP-4844 Blob (Type 3)
5. Verify each type has format-specific validation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Data DATA-TRANSACTION. Validates completeness of transaction data validation across all supported transaction types.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-JWT-TOKEN validation prevents unauthorized Engine API access
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT handling in node/jwt_handler.go or node/rpcstack.go
2. Verify JWT structure validation:
a. Header alg must be HS256
b. Reject 'none' algorithm
c. Reject RS/ES algorithms (prevent key confusion)
3. Verify 'iat' claim processing:
a. Must be present
b. Within ±60 seconds of current time
4. Verify secret loading from jwt.hex file
5. Check for JWT secret rotation handling
6. Verify constant-time token comparison
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE-001 → Data DATA-JWT-TOKEN. JWT provides integrity and authenticity guarantees for Engine API communication.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD structural validation before processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ExecutableData structure in beacon/engine/types.go
2. Verify structural validation in eth/catalyst/api.go:
a. Parent hash references existing block
b. Timestamp > parent timestamp
c. Block number = parent number + 1
d. Block hash matches computed hash
e. Transaction root matches Merkle root of transactions
3. Check version-specific fields (Shanghai withdrawals, Cancun blobs)
4. Verify error responses for structural failures
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD-001 → Data DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD. Even from trusted CL, payload content requires structural validation before processing.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-STATE-OBJECT changes are only committed for validated blocks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate stateObject in core/state/state_object.go
2. Verify dirty tracking for modified objects
3. Check commit flow in core/state/statedb.go:
a. Only dirty objects are committed
b. Commit occurs after validation success
4. Verify state journal for rollback capability
5. Check snapshot mechanism for reverting invalid changes
6. Verify no dangling uncommitted state on error paths
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALID-COMMIT-001 → Data DATA-STATE-OBJECT. State changes must only be committed for fully validated blocks. Rollback on validation failure.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-BLOB-SIDECAR KZG commitments are correct for Cancun+ payloads
detection_procedure: 1. Locate blob sidecar handling in core/types/tx_blob.go
2. Verify KZG commitment computation in crypto/kzg4844/
3. Check blob-to-commitment mapping correctness
4. Verify commitment proofs are generated correctly
5. Check versioned hash computation (0x01 + hash(commitment)[1:])
6. Verify blob limit per block enforcement
7. Check EIP-4844 gas accounting for blobs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETRIEVED-001 → Data DATA-BLOB-SIDECAR. Block hash integrity and blob KZG commitments must be verified for Cancun+ payloads.

checklist.title: Verify DoS protections for P2P transaction reception from peers
detection_procedure: 1. Locate P2P message handling in eth/protocols/eth/handlers.go
2. Verify rate limiting per peer:
a. Maximum transactions per message
b. Maximum pending from single peer
3. Check fee requirements for pool acceptance
4. Verify peer scoring and disconnection for abuse
5. Check memory limits for pending transaction storage
6. Verify CPU limits for signature verification batching
7. Check for amplification attack prevention
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-TX-RECEIVE-001 → Actor ACTOR-P2P-PEER. DoS protections (rate limiting, fee requirements) help mitigate abuse from semi-trusted peers.

checklist.title: Verify peer penalization for invalid block submission
detection_procedure: 1. Locate peer scoring in eth/protocols/eth/peer.go
2. Verify penalty application for invalid blocks:
a. Invalid header
b. Invalid transaction root
c. Invalid state root
3. Check disconnection threshold configuration
4. Verify banning duration for severe violations
5. Check for eclipse attack prevention mechanisms
6. Verify peer diversity requirements

executable_checks.assertion: Peer penalization for bad blocks exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE-001 → Actor ACTOR-P2P-PEER. Invalid blocks must trigger peer penalization. Critical for consensus attack resistance.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-EVM-CONTEXT is correctly set before EVM execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EVM context in core/vm/evm.go BlockContext and TxContext
2. Verify block context fields are set correctly:
a. BlockNumber from header
b. Time from header timestamp
c. Coinbase from header (or fee recipient)
d. BaseFee for EIP-1559
e. Random for post-merge
3. Verify transaction context:
a. Origin = transaction sender
b. GasPrice = effective gas price
4. Check context immutability during execution
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-APPLY-001 → Data DATA-EVM-CONTEXT. Context correctness is essential for deterministic execution and opcode behavior.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-MESSAGE correctly encapsulates transaction for EVM execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Message type in core/types/transaction.go or core/state_transition.go
2. Verify message construction from transaction:
a. From address = recovered signer
b. To address from transaction
c. Value from transaction
d. Gas limit from transaction (minus intrinsic)
e. Data = transaction input data
3. Check access list conversion for EIP-2930+
4. Verify blob hashes for EIP-4844
5. Check message immutability guarantees
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-APPLY-001 → Data DATA-MESSAGE. Message contains untrusted user input in Data field. Must be correctly constructed from signed transaction.

checklist.title: Verify gas limits prevent unbounded resource consumption during contract creation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Create/Create2 in core/vm/evm.go
2. Verify gas deduction before initcode execution
3. Check EIP-3860 initcode size limit and gas cost:
a. Max size: 49152 bytes
b. Gas cost: 2 gas per word of initcode
4. Verify gas return for unused gas after successful creation
5. Check all-or-nothing semantics (fail consumes all gas)
6. Verify deployment code gas cost (200 gas per byte)
7. Check gas limit propagation to nested calls
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-ST-CREATE-001 → Action ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CREATE. Gas limits and EIP-3860 constraints bound resource consumption for untrusted initcode.

checklist.title: Verify state isolation during contract call execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Call in core/vm/evm.go
2. Verify each call frame has isolated memory (core/vm/memory.go)
3. Check stack isolation between frames
4. Verify storage access is scoped to called contract:
a. SLOAD/SSTORE access caller's storage in DELEGATECALL
b. SLOAD/SSTORE access callee's storage in CALL
5. Verify return data is copied, not referenced
6. Check journaling for revert capability
7. Verify STATICCALL prevents state modifications
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-EDGE-ST-CALL-001 → Action ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CALL. EVM sandboxing through gas metering, stack/memory limits, and state isolation.

checklist.title: Verify secp256k1 signature verification is correctly implemented
detection_procedure: 1. Locate signature handling in core/types/transaction_signing.go
2. Verify Ecrecover implementation in crypto/signature_cgo.go or crypto/signature_nocgo.go
3. Check R, S range validation (must be < secp256k1 order)
4. Verify V value handling for different transaction types:
a. Legacy: V = 27/28 or 27+chainId*2+8/9
5. Check for signature malleability prevention
6. Verify recovery returns correct public key/address
7. Check for null signature or edge case handling
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Action ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. secp256k1 signature verification is the primary cryptographic guarantee for transaction authenticity.

checklist.title: Verify transaction nonce validation prevents replay attacks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate nonce validation in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go
2. Verify pending nonce tracking per account
3. Check nonce gap handling:
a. Transaction with nonce > pending+queuedMax is rejected
b. Transaction with nonce < pending is rejected (already executed)
4. Verify nonce ordering in transaction queue
5. Check nonce update after successful execution in state_transition.go
6. Verify chain ID is incorporated in signature for replay protection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Action ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. Nonce validation prevents transaction replay and ensures correct ordering.

checklist.title: Verify balance sufficiency check prevents overdraft
detection_procedure: 1. Locate balance check in core/txpool/validation.go
2. Verify cost calculation: gasLimit * gasPrice + value
3. For EIP-1559: gasLimit * maxFeePerGas + value
4. For EIP-4844: add blob gas cost
5. Verify balance is checked against sender's current balance
6. Check for integer overflow in cost calculation
7. Verify pending balance calculation for queued transactions
8. Check balance re-validation during execution
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-001 → Action ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. Balance check: account.Balance >= tx.GasPrice * tx.GasLimit + tx.Value.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE processing after JWT validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ForkchoiceStateV1 in beacon/engine/types.go
2. Verify processing in eth/catalyst/api.go ForkchoiceUpdatedV*
3. Check headBlockHash validation:
a. Must be valid block hash format
b. Referenced block should exist or trigger sync
4. Verify safeBlockHash and finalizedBlockHash handling
5. Check consistency requirements between head/safe/finalized
6. Verify error handling for invalid block references
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE-001 → Data DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE. Fork choice state determines canonical chain. Only processed after JWT validation.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-PAYLOAD-ATTRIBUTES validation and block building trigger
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PayloadAttributes in beacon/engine/types.go
2. Verify version-specific fields:
a. V1: timestamp, random, suggestedFeeRecipient
b. V2: + withdrawals (Shanghai)
c. V3: + parentBeaconBlockRoot (Cancun)
3. Check timestamp validation (must be > parent timestamp)
4. Verify fee recipient is valid address
5. Check withdrawals format validation
6. Verify payload ID generation is unique and unpredictable
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE-001 → Data DATA-PAYLOAD-ATTRIBUTES. Payload attributes trigger block building when present in forkchoiceUpdated.

checklist.title: Verify complete header validation for P2P received blocks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate header validation in core/block_validator.go or consensus/beacon/consensus.go
2. Verify all header field validations:
a. Parent hash matches known block
b. Block number = parent number + 1
c. Timestamp > parent timestamp
d. Gas used <= gas limit
e. Gas limit within bounds of parent
f. Extra data size limit
3. Check post-merge validations (difficulty=0, nonce=0)
4. Verify withdrawals root for Shanghai+
5. Check blob gas handling for Cancun+
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE-001 → Data DATA-BLOCK. Complete header validation is mandatory for blocks from P2P. Includes timestamp, gas, difficulty (post-merge).

checklist.title: Verify state root verification after transaction execution for P2P blocks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate state processor in core/state_processor.go
2. Trace state root comparison after ProcessBlock
3. Verify computed state root is compared against header state root
4. Check all transactions are executed before comparison
5. Verify mismatch causes block rejection (not just logging)
6. Check for any optimistic execution that defers validation
7. Verify receipts root is also validated
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BOUNDARY-IMPLICIT-P2P-BLOCK-RECEIVE-001 → Data DATA-BLOCK. State root verification is the final check that all transactions executed correctly and produced expected state.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TX-PENDING pool invariant: all transactions are validated
detection_procedure: 1. Locate pending pool in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go
2. Verify all insertion paths go through validateTx()
3. Check pool reset logic maintains invariant after reorg
4. Verify demoted transactions from pending are re-validated
5. Check no internal paths bypass validation
6. Verify concurrent access doesn't corrupt invariant
7. Check replacement transaction validation (same nonce, higher gas)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TX-INCLUDED-001 → State STATE-TX-PENDING. Pool invariant ensures all pending transactions have passed validation. Defense in depth.

checklist.title: Verify JWT validation occurs before any payload processing
detection_procedure: 1. Trace HTTP request handling in node/rpcstack.go
2. Verify JWT middleware is applied before RPC dispatch
3. Check handler chain ordering
4. Verify no payload parsing occurs before JWT check
5. Check error responses don't leak payload information pre-auth
6. Verify websocket connections also require JWT
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD-001 → Action ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. Authentication must complete before any payload parsing to prevent information leakage.

checklist.title: Verify PayloadID validation in getPayload prevents unauthorized retrieval
detection_procedure: 1. Locate getPayload in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify PayloadID format and generation
3. Check PayloadID to payload mapping storage
4. Verify ID cannot be guessed or enumerated
5. Check payload expiration/cleanup
6. Verify error response for invalid PayloadID
7. Check concurrent access safety for payload retrieval
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD-001 → Action ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD. PayloadID must be valid and correspond to authenticated prior request.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID is only reached after complete validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block valid state in core/blockchain.go or eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace all paths leading to state commit
3. Verify state root comparison occurs before commit
4. Check receipts root verification
5. Verify transaction root verification
6. Check for any premature commit paths
7. Verify atomic transition: validation success -> commit
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALID-COMMIT-001 → State STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID. This state is only reached after successful validation. Commit gate for state persistence.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE performs atomic state commitment
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Commit in core/state/statedb.go
2. Verify batch write to database (no partial commits)
3. Check database transaction usage
4. Verify MPT nodes are committed atomically
5. Check for crash recovery mechanisms
6. Verify commit returns root hash for verification
7. Check snapshot consistency with committed state
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALID-COMMIT-001 → Action ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE. State commitment is atomic and verified. No partial state should be persisted.
